{{short description|German mathematician and professor}}
'''Johann Wilhelm Andreas Pfaff''' (5 December 1774 – 26 June 1835) was professor of pure and [[applied mathematics]] successively at [[Dorpat University|Dorpat]], Nuremberg, Würzburg and [[University of Erlangen-Nuremberg|Erlangen]]. He was a brother of [[Johann Friedrich Pfaff]], a mathematician; and of [[Christian Heinrich Pfaff]], a physician and physicist.
